import json

# Parse the raw JSON from lookup_output
raw_json_part = lookup_output.split("---RAW_JSON---")[1].split("(.venv)")[0].strip()
data = json.loads(raw_json_part)

# Build report lines without any backticks
header = "# Friends Contact Lookup Results"
separator = "---"
entries = []
for name, contacts in data.items():
    entries.append("## " + name)
    for c in contacts:
        entries.append("- Name: " + c.get("name", "N/A"))
        entries.append("  - Person ID: " + c.get("person_id", "N/A"))
        entries.append("  - Phone: " + c.get("phone_number", "N/A"))
        entries.append("  - Relationship: " + c.get("relationship", "N/A"))
    entries.append("")

json_section = "## Raw JSON Data"
json_dump = json.dumps(data, indent=2)

all_lines = [header, "", separator.join([""] * 1)]
all_lines.extend(entries)
all_lines.append(separator)
all_lines.append("")
all_lines.append(json_section)
all_lines.append("")
all_lines.append(json_dump)
all_lines.append("")

file_content = chr(10).join(all_lines)
print("Content ready, length=" + str(len(file_content)))
